reason: Implements static GTM installation and duplicate-risk audits alongside generic web-audit tools; no GTM account/container API access or configuration mutations.
exposure: All seven tools registered unconditionally by default; measure_performance remains exposed when Playwright/Chromium is missing but returns installation guidance. Every tool has only the required URL parameter, with no input defaults or nested parameters.
limitations: Offline MCP initialize/tools/list verified registrations and schemas only; no tool operations or live web audits were invoked.

Tracking tools scan served HTML only: runtime-injected GTM/CMP tags, actual event firing, container contents and consent behavior are unobservable; server-side/first-party findings are URL-pattern heuristics.
measure_performance dynamically imports Playwright, which is a devDependency, and additionally requires an installed Chromium browser; npm production installs can lack the package.
Page-weight GET fallback uses fetched body bytes, which may be decompressed by the fetch client; reports should not be assumed to be exact wire-transfer sizes.

tools.name: audit_page
tools.description: One-shot audit of a URL: tracking tags, duplicate-tag risks, response-header hygiene, and resource counts, as a single readable report. Fast (no browser). For byte-level page weight use analyze_page_weight; for lab Core Web Vitals use measure_performance.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to audit, e.g. https://example.com

tools.behavior: Fetches served HTML and combines static GTM/analytics detection, duplicate-risk heuristics, response headers and resource counts without running page JavaScript.

tools.name: detect_tracking_tags
tools.description: Static scan of a page's HTML for analytics/advertising tags: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Universal Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Pixel, TikTok, LinkedIn Insight, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, server-side/first-party tagging, and consent platforms. Reports IDs and where each was found.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to audit, e.g. https://example.com

tools.behavior: Parses served HTML for tag loader URLs, inline IDs, noscript pixels and consent signatures, including GTM and heuristic first-party/server-side signals; does not execute scripts or inspect container contents.

tools.name: find_duplicate_tags
tools.description: Flag duplicate GA4/GTM/pixel installations and double-fire patterns: same ID initialized twice, multiple containers, hardcoded GA4 next to GTM, multiple pixel IDs, legacy UA leftovers.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to audit, e.g. https://example.com

tools.behavior: Analyzes static HTML findings for multiple GTM container IDs, repeated inline initializations and GTM plus hardcoded GA4 coexistence; cannot confirm runtime double firing or inspect the container.

tools.name: measure_performance
tools.description: Load the page in headless Chromium (Playwright) and capture lab metrics: TTFB, FCP, LCP, CLS, load times, request count and transfer sizes. Clearly labeled lab data, not field data. Requires the Playwright Chromium browser; returns the install command if missing.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to audit, e.g. https://example.com

tools.behavior: General web-performance tool loads the URL in headless Chromium, waits three seconds after load, and reports browser Performance API lab timing and resource totals without inspecting GTM configuration or event firing.

tools.name: analyze_page_weight
tools.description: Static page-weight analysis: counts and byte sizes of scripts, stylesheets, images, fonts and iframes referenced in the HTML, plus the largest third-party scripts. Measures up to 30 resources with capped, guarded requests.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to audit, e.g. https://example.com

tools.behavior: General web-page sizing tool extracts HTML-referenced resources and sizes at most 30 using guarded HEAD requests with capped GET fallback, without executing JavaScript.

tools.name: check_headers
tools.description: Inspect the page's HTTP response headers: caching policy, compression, HSTS, CSP, clickjacking protection, referrer policy, CDN presence. Informational grades with explanations, no synthetic scores.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to audit, e.g. https://example.com

tools.behavior: General HTTP hygiene tool fetches the URL and reports caching, compression and security/CDN response-header checks.

tools.name: tracking_summary
tools.description: Plain-language summary of a site's tracking setup written for a media buyer or marketer: what is installed, what it means for campaigns, consent posture, and issues to raise with the dev team.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to audit, e.g. https://example.com

tools.behavior: Turns static HTML tracking detections and duplicate heuristics into a marketer-facing summary, including GTM IDs and consent signals, without checking live event delivery.

review.summary: Scan page HTML for installed GTM containers, duplicate installations, and tracking configuration patterns.
